comment.body: Gracias por el informe y el archivo de diagnostico. El registro contiene `Rejected SettingsSync server: untrusted-signature`, el mismo rechazo investigado en #51567 y #50795. #51789 propone corregir la comprobacion de firmas de Microsoft, pero sigue abierto y no es una correccion publicada. No hace falta enviar otro archivo ni repetir las comprobaciones de red para este rechazo local. Eviten sustituir ejecutables entre versiones o desactivar la verificacion; la validacion de la correccion debe usar una compilacion coherente y firmada.

fix_assessment.rationale: An open candidate explicitly covers the demonstrated rejection class; this is existing ownership, not a shipped repair.

known_information: The Spanish report supplies version0.102.3001, failed pairing/key refresh, two screenshots and a diagnostic archive.
Read the supplied archive: MouseWithoutBordersViewModel.GetSettingsSyncHelperAsync repeatedly reports System.UnauthorizedAccessException: Rejected SettingsSync server: untrusted-signature.
Current open PR51789 explicitly targets51567 by independently checking trusted Microsoft signatures instead of requiring identical leaf certificates. It is not merged or shipped.
issue_context.summary: Supplied archive confirms the known local SettingsSync signature rejection; route to the existing investigation and open fix.
initial_investigation: Read complete issue body, all comments and timeline cross-references.
Downloaded the supplied ZIP and read its Settings/MWB diagnostic entries; no archive executable or community workaround was run.
Read current51789description and open/unmerged state. Only the static failure signature is exposed; machine identities and keys remain private.
inferences: Matching local rejection establishes grouping with the existing investigation; the archive alone does not independently prove every certificate property or validate the proposed repair.
issue_context.analysis: The diagnostic evidence establishes the same local verification rejection, not merely a generic remote network symptom. Existing investigation and candidate ownership cover it. Preserve release-status uncertainty and do not recommend swapping binaries or weakening verification.
